pedagogic_emphasis.basis: authored pedagogic emphasis (product policy): sum of member node emphasis

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Lay out the GDL frame, then Segment 1 start age and hours, the Segment 2 entry log and classroom hours, and the shared exam score.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per segment requirement; contrast card for the shared seventy percent score.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz that swaps segment hours, ages and scores.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach Level 1 eligibility and documents, who may supervise and how, the driving log, and the phone ban.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Eligibility, supervision and log cards; contrast cards for the one-month age gap and supervising adults.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on who may supervise and what Level 1 needs.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the four conditions for the skills test, what to bring, and the two different hour counts.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Condition and document cards; contrast card for thirty versus fifty hours.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on whether a described teen may take the skills test.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach Level 2 eligibility, hard-card and paper-card paths, then the night, passenger and phone limits with their exceptions.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Eligibility and restriction cards; contrast cards for night versus passenger limits and their exceptions.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz applying the Level 2 limits to trip scenarios.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach Level 3 eligibility and issuance, then contrast the record look-back windows and the age ladder.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Level 3 cards plus contrast cards for ninety days versus twelve months and the age ladder.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on which level a described teen qualifies for.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Walk the adult path: TIP, four proofs, the free knowledge test, TIP steps, thirty days of practice, then the mailed license.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Step cards in order; contrast cards for days versus hours and the free test.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on the adult path order and costs.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach each proof type: Social Security, legal presence, matching names, identity originals, and residency documents and dates.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per proof rule; contrast card for the sixty-day and ninety-day windows.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on whether a described document is accepted.

learning_path_rule.rule: module order sec02-m01..sec02-m07; component facts before the synthesis (R) nodes that contrast them; no dynamic nodes exist

node_types.definition: one accepted handbook fact as an atomic node
one accepted C2 contrast fact joining the component facts it names

edge_types.definition: component fact must be learned before the contrast or dependent fact

domain_emphasis_check.domain: Graduated Driver Licensing and application documents

sequencing.rule: module order, then component facts before synthesis nodes
